info.name: Radix Connect API — Phase 1
info.description:
Radix Connect Phase 1.

**Pillars covered**
- People — Profiles + New Joiner Quest
- Connect — Blind Meetups + Mentoring
- Communities — Interest Groups
- Learn & Share — Recommendations + AMA
- Do Together — Events
- Celebrate & Discover — Stories

**Getting started**
1. Set `base_url` (default `http://localhost:8000`).
2. Run `00 · Auth → Demo login` — just a name and the shared password `Radix123`. The token is captured into the `token` variable automatically and every other request inherits bearer auth from the collection.

Sign in as `Anuj Maurya` for the admin role (needed to create Blind Meetup rounds and run matching). Any unrecognised name creates a fresh profile with its own New Joiner Quest. Real email/password auth still works: seeded accounts use `Radix123` as their password.

**Conventions**
- Single resources: `{ "data": { ... } }`. Lists are paginated: `{ "data": [...], "links": {...}, "meta": {...} }`.
- Errors: `{ "message": "..." }`, with `{ "errors": { field: [...] } }` on 422.
- All timestamps are ISO 8601 UTC.

item.name: 00 · Auth
item.description:
Bearer token auth via Sanctum.

**Demo login** is the quick path: a name plus the shared password `Radix123`. Real email/password register and login are left intact alongside it.

Either way the token lands in the `{{token}}` collection variable automatically, and every other request inherits bearer auth from the collection.

request.description:
**Start here.** The demo sign-in screen asks only for a name and the shared password `Radix123` — no per-user credentials.

An unrecognised name creates a profile on the spot (with its New Joiner Quest), so anyone can sign in and land somewhere useful. `Anuj Maurya` is the seeded admin.

Returns a normal Sanctum token, so every other request behaves exactly as under real auth.
Creates the account and immediately builds their New Joiner Quest.
Seeded accounts all use the password `password`. admin@radix.email has the admin role.
The signed-in user's full profile, including all four tag sections.
Revokes the current token only.
Every dropdown option the UI needs: teams, locations, categories, streams, reaction types.
One call for the home screen: quest, current blind meetup round, pending session requests, upcoming events, open AMAs, latest recommendations and stories.

item.name: 02 · People — Profiles
item.description: Pillar: People. Profiles answer 'why might I want to talk to this person?' rather than acting as an employee directory.

request.description: Free-text across name, job title, intro, team, location and tags.
Tag slug. Use /tags to discover slugs.
kind is one of can_talk_about, can_help_with, want_to_learn, interest.
senior = 6+ years at Radix, junior = under 6. Same split the Blind Meetups use.

body.raw:
{
  "job_title": "Staff Engineer",
  "team": "Engineering",
  "location": "Mumbai",
  "timezone": "Asia/Kolkata",
  "intro": "Backends, hiring and long treks.",
  "pronouns": "he/him",
  "avatar_url": "https://i.pravatar.cc/300",
  "open_to_mentoring": true,
  "open_to_blind_meetups": true
}

request.description: Replaces that one profile section. Tags are created on the fly if new. Send an empty array to clear it.

item.name: 03 · People — New Joiner Quest
item.description: Five people to meet in the first month. Suggestions deliberately cross teams, locations and tenure groups, and each carries a reason.

request.description: Built automatically on first request if it does not exist yet.
status: pending | met | skipped. The quest completes itself once none are pending.

item.name: 04 · Connect — Blind Meetups
item.description: Monthly opt-in. 6+ years at Radix pairs with under 6 years; different team and location are preferred. Meetup lands on the last Friday of the month.

request.description: Includes my_signup and my_pair so the UI knows whether to show Sign up, Withdraw or the match.
`partner` is the other person, from your point of view.
status: proposed | scheduled | completed | missed.
meetup_date defaults to the last Friday of the period's month.
Pairs every signup it can across the tenure split. Re-running replaces the existing pairs.

item.name: 05 · Connect — Mentoring Sessions
item.description: 30 minutes with someone, asked for on the strength of something on their profile. The recipient accepts, declines or suggests another time.

request.description: category: work_knowledge | career | leadership | people | technical | personal_experience.

body.raw:
{
  "recipient_id": 2,
  "topic": "Getting started with BigQuery ML",
  "category": "technical",
  "tag_id": null,
  "message": "Saw this on your profile \u2014 30 minutes whenever suits you?",
  "duration_minutes": 30,
  "proposed_at": "2026-10-02T10:00:00Z"
}

request.description: Recipient only. action: accept | decline | suggest_time.

item.name: 06 · Communities — Interest Groups
item.description: Discovery only. The actual community carries on in WhatsApp, Slack or wherever it already lives.

request.description: The creator becomes the owner and first member.

item.name: 07 · Learn & Share — Recommendations
item.description: Two streams, Work and Leisure. Every recommendation carries a 'why I recommend this'.

request.description: type: book | podcast | article | show | film | course | tool. stream: work | leisure.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Thinking in Systems",
  "creator": "Donella Meadows",
  "type": "book",
  "stream": "work",
  "url": "https://example.com/thinking-in-systems",
  "why": "Changed how I look at feedback loops in our own product."
}

item.name: 08 · Learn & Share — AMAs
item.description: Anyone with interesting experience can host one, async or live.

request.description: format: async | live. For live, set scheduled_at and location.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Ask me about training for HYROX",
  "description": "Six months, one torn calf, finished anyway.",
  "format": "async",
  "status": "open",
  "opens_at": "2026-09-12T00:00:00Z",
  "closes_at": "2026-09-30T00:00:00Z"
}

request.description: Questions come back sorted by upvotes, each with its answers and is_upvoted for the viewer.
Author, AMA host or admin.

item.name: 09 · Do Together — Events
item.description: Anyone creates an activity, others join. Radix Connect does discovery and RSVPs; detailed coordination moves elsewhere.

request.description: The host is RSVP'd as going automatically.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Sunday run at Powai Lake",
  "description": "Easy 8k, coffee after.",
  "category": "sports",
  "starts_at": "2026-09-20T06:30:00Z",
  "ends_at": "2026-09-20T08:00:00Z",
  "location": "Mumbai",
  "is_virtual": false,
  "capacity": 15,
  "interest_group_id": null,
  "status": "published"
}

request.description: status: going | maybe | not_going. Refused with 422 if the event is full.

item.name: 10 · Celebrate & Discover — Stories
item.description: Beyond-work stories. Not recognition or awards — the point is 'I didn't know this about that person.'

request.description: category: sport | travel | learning | making | milestone | other.
reaction: clap | heart | mind_blown | inspired. One reaction per person, re-posting replaces it.
A Story can naturally become an AMA. Links both ways; 422 if one already exists.
